description: Ministry of Parliamentary Reforms and Mass Media  - Amendment to the approval of the Rules of Right to Information Act No. 12 of 2016 of Gazette Ex.Ord. No. 2004/66 of 03.02.2017
reasoning: This gazette content pertains to the amendment of rules under the Right to Information Act, No. 12 of 2016. It involves regulatory matters, specifically the modification of fees for information requests and the format for appeals, which falls under the Legal/Regulatory classification (Type 5) for statutory instruments and subsidiary legislation.
